prerequisites: Ability to analyse and structure simple interactive applications
Expertise gained in foundational courses to understand the development logic of interactive and multimedia environments

learning_outcomes.text: Provide students with theoretical and practical skills in the development of interactive digital content using Unity.
Provide students with the knowledge and skills needed to create interactive digital content, virtual 2D and 3D environments, and simple multimedia applications using the Unity game engine.

Enable students to apply their knowledge and understanding in evaluating development tools for interactive prototyping, implementing game logic and dynamic elements through Unity scripting, organizing project structures, and optimizing functionality for standard devices (desktop and mobile).

Allow students to select the most effective strategies for designing interactive environments aligned with project goals. They will be able to choose the most suitable approaches among various programming, layout, and interaction solutions, and critically assess the outcomes of their implementations.

Clearly articulate their design choices, the techniques used, and the functionalities developed in their projects. Additionally, students will enhance their ability to produce technical documentation and present their work through intuitive interfaces and visual feedback.

Through hands-on activities and practical project development, students will be able to integrate the knowledge gained in other courses with advanced digital tools for multimedia content creation. The course framework fosters independent exploration of new Unity features and support libraries, as well as the ability to investigate emerging technologies in creative and interactive domains, presenting concise and effective summaries of their results.

syllabus_topics: Introduction to the course and development environment
assessment_rules: The student will be evaluated with a written final exam. Grading is based on a final score.
bibliography: Joseph Hocking, Unity in Action, Third Edition: Multiplatform game development in C#, Manning, 2022.
